sources.title: Denver Broncos roster review: Long snapper Luke Basso
sources.description: The Denver Broncos went for Oregon long snapper Luke Basso after the 2026 NFL Draft as they presumably look to add some competition to the position heading into this season. He likely caught the eye of Broncos’ scouts during the Senior Bowl back in February. Denver is known for picking up undrafted players they scouted […]
